content: yeah the center back for mine just spins I think it got stripped and zero replacements or way to fix
indx tool offset sensor need to come off for bottom right

IMPORTANT, read this before proceeding.

I tried this part here, and after aligning joints, all of them turned away wrongly while tightening. Here's my suggestion for this step.

First, tighten all screws lightly, so the expansion joint can still move but the bed is already somewhat fixed and centered.
Skip ahead until you see the tightening order. Tighten the middle screw first, but completely. Then, proceed with the 4 middle ones the following way:

Put on the aligner tool up to the heatbed and turn it slightly counter-clockwise, so the joint is slightly off from the preferred rotation. Start tightening the screw and keep the joint actively from turning by holding it slightly turned. Finish tightening the screw either fully, or if the expansion joint didnt turn AT ALL, help turning it a bit by cancelling the counter rotation on the tool for the last millimeter of screw-tightening.
Loosen the tool up and slide it back on fully to verify that the joint has the correct orientation. If it doesn't, dont fully loosen the screw, just make slight adjustments with the tool and the torx screwdriver simultaneously. Verify again, skip to the next one.

For the one on the front right, I looked over the 45° edge of the board straight, so i couldn't see the face of the 45 edge anymore, looking perfectly over it. I now oriented that joint perfectly parallel to the edge, so it has the correct orientation as well.

I take no responsibility for what happens when you follow my guide, however, this is what worked best and fastest for me and I thought i'd share if someone has the same troubles.

If you have INDX FE and avoided taking the sides off because of the 8 spool holders, you will need to raise the bed to approx 0mm (top) to do this 😅

Also the INDX tool offset sensor would need to be removed but I just ignored that corner

I feel like this entire step step is not necessary and made the expansion joints less even and pushed some out from being properly seated
